title: Berkeley high school: jazz records, Louis Armstrong, teaching himself
summary: In high school in Berkeley friends introduced him to jazz records, starting with Louis Armstrong, and he confirms he is self-taught.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Growing up with radio, records and family listening

blocks.x: Now, at this highschool in Berkeley, you did say......
I met some friends who were buying jazz records
Do you remember what some of the first records were?
Oh, as they would say now, that turned you on, huh? (LAUGHTER).
Did you have a Victrola as they called it then, at home?
Yes, yes, uhu. And was there anybody in the house who helped you to see what your potential was in high school?
So then that accounts in large measure for the fact that you (are self-taught ), is that right?
